title: Arkret Recovery Completion Carriers
description: Closed recovery completion attestation and Standard-grant issuance carriers. Device recovery is authorized by the accepted PCR recovery policy; an optional DID-root proof is only one explicitly enabled factor. When deployment policy permits reactivation, the same completed closure is the only operation that may atomically author a deactivated-to-active successor for the original account before issuing its new-generation Standard grant.

issue_recovery_completion_grant_response.description: Exact durable outcome for one completed recovery transaction. If the original account was deactivated, successful issuance also means the Account Authority atomically restored that same account and authored its deactivated-to-active successor; no replacement account or second PCR is created.

recovery_completion_grant_request_body.description: Fresh Bound AccountHandoff and DPoP authenticate this request. The original owning Station supplies the exact successful completion through the existing authenticated deployment-internal channel; the caller supplies only its original signed receipt and the new holder intent/accepted-device proof. canonical_request_digest=SHA-256(JCS(this request with only canonical_request_digest omitted)), computed after the possession proof. The proof intent is SHA-256(JCS({receipt_digest,initial_session})), where receipt_digest hashes the full signed terminal_receipt. Completion issuance is unique by (issuer_id, operation, full AccountId, receipt.transaction_id).

recovery_completion_attestation.description: Owning-Station Ed25519 completion over JCS of all actual members except signature_proof. terminal_receipt_digest is SHA-256(JCS(full signed RecoveryReceipt)). It proves one logical atomic recovery accepted the two inline Event submissions, issued different consecutive Commits in the same PCR stream, activated the candidate, advanced generation and consumed the original session.

account_id.description: Exact recovered account. Its station_id is the coordinator: the service signer/route authority of the Station-local recovery transaction. No separate coordinator field exists on wire or in the signed projection.

completed_at.description: Server-side linearized commit time of the single atomic recovery commit. It MUST NOT be earlier than the terminal receipt completed_at, which is only an authoring time.

signature.description: Canonical Base64URL Ed25519 signature over RFC8785_JCS(the complete closed attestation with only signature_proof omitted). Schema identity, exact signed receipt digest and both real committed references are covered.

reanchor_event_ref.description: CommittedEventRef of the recovery re-anchor Event in the account PCR stream. It sits at position n, immediately before device_authorization_event_ref, in its own RealmCommit.

device_authorization_event_ref.description: CommittedEventRef of the replacement-device authorization Event. It sits at position n+1 of the same PCR Realm stream as reanchor_event_ref, in its own RealmCommit accepted by the same atomic recovery transaction.
